new_interesting_lines: * [[Sideswipe]] and [[Ratchet]] will be punished with every critical melee hit.
*[[Ironhide (ROTF)]]’s critical hits are all in this ranged attacks, which Bonecrusher's Bleeds have no answer to.

*[[Optimus Prime (MV1)]] can recover health and convert the second bleed into Power while Bleeding while attacking him. You’ve seen their clash in the first Bayverse transformers film and it remains true!

Do not use Scout or other Warrior Bots that constantly hit with Critical melee attacks, or else they will quickly lose health from Bleeding. Since Brawlers and most Demolition bots have a low melee critical rate (and [[Thundercracker]] literally cannot score them), they are the best classes to use against Bonecrusher.

Bonecrusher|Faction = Decepticon|Class = [[Warrior]]|image = Bonecrusher featured.png|Origin = Live-action film series|Release Date = Launch}} ==Bio== ''A noted speed skater and general purveyor of hate, Bonecrusher oozes with disdain for everything and everyone, including himself. Based on his savagery in battle, one might be led to believe his only true love is dishing out pain and punishment.'' ==Max Stats== '''1-Star''' *Health: 970 *Attack: 93 *Max Rating: 248 '''2-Star''' *Health: 1786 *Attack: 157 *Max Rating: 544 (sig 100, forge 3) '''3-Star''' *Health: 4,339 *Attack: 331 *Max Rating: 1,287 (sig 100) '''4-Star''' *Health: 11,276 *Attack: 860 *Max Rating: 3432 (sig 99) **2864 (sig 0) '''5-Star''' {| class="article-table" !Rank/Level !Health !Attack !Rating !sig |- |1/1 |6,060 |462 |1401 | |- |1/10 |9,558 |729 |2,236 | |- |2/20 |12,450 |949 |2,911 | |- |3/30 |16,607 |1,267 |3,957 | |- |4/40 |21,585 |1,646 |5,723 |15 |- |5/50 |27,375 |2,086 |8,319 |99 |} ==Game Abilities== ===Basic Abilities=== * Crit Rate Buff * [[Bleed]] === Abilities === * ''When struck by melee critical hits:'' 59-90% chance to Bleed, dealing 67.2-89.6% Attack over 7 seconds. * ''Passive'': Opponents trigger 25% fewer Evades per stack of Bleed. * ''Opponent's Special Attacks'': Bonecrusher's hate toward the opponent grows. This raises his Attack by 100% Critical Rating on Heavy and Special Attacks for 8 seconds. * ''Heavy Attacks:'' - 70% chance to Bleed, dealing 45% attack over 5.6 seconds. {| class="article-table" !Rank !Bleed Chance !Bleed !Crit Rate !SP1 Bleed Chance !SP1 Bleed !SP2 Bleed !SP3 Bleed Chance !SP3 Bleed !SP3 Bleed Duration |- |1 |59% |67.2% |12% |59.4% |105% |47% |30% |129% |11 seconds |- |2 |65.6% |70% |14% |66% |107.5% |52.4% |32.5% |144% |13 seconds |- |3 |72.9% |75.6% |16% |73% |110% |58.3% |35% |160% |14 seconds |- |4 |81% |81.2% |19% |81% |112.5% |64.8% |40% |178% |16 seconds |- |5 |90% |89.6% |22% |90% |115% |72% |45% |198% |18 seconds |- |6 |94% |96% |26% |100% |117.5% |80% |50% |220% |20 seconds |} ===Signature Ability=== '''Pure Hate''' ''Bleeding opponents fuel Bonecrusher's hatred, raising his Attack and Power Rate while reducing the opponent's.'' * Passive: Bleeding opponents fuel Bonecrusher's hatred, raising his Attack by 16% and Power Rate by 7~30% per stack of Bleed. Opponent's Attack and Power Rate are reduced by the same amount. * + about 0.3% per level. {| class="article-table" !Level !Power Rate |- |'''5''' |7% |- |10 |8.6% |- |15 |10.1% |- |20 |11.5% |- |25 |12.8% |- |30 |14.1% |- |35 |15.3% |- |40 |16.6% |- |45 |17.8% |- |50 |19% |- |55 |20.1% |- |60 |21.3% |- |65 |22.4% |- |70 |23.5% |- |75 |24.6% |- |80 |25.7% |- |85 |26.8% |- |90 |27.9% |- |95 |28.9% |- |99 |29.8% |- |'''100''' |30% |} ===Special Attacks=== # '''Scorpion Sting''' - ''Side effects may include pain, paresthesia, and instant death.'' #*59.4~90% chance to Bleed, dealing 105~115% Attack over 2 seconds. # '''Abhornado''' - ''A savage pirouette of claws and hatred.'' #*71% chance to Bleed, dealing 47~72% Attack over 7 seconds. # '''No Survivors!''' - ''There is no nobility in retreat. No bone will be left uncrushed.'' #*30~45% chance to Bleed, dealing 129~198% Attack over 11-18 seconds. ===Synergy Bonuses=== *[[File:synergy-outgoing.jpg]] '''Allies''' - [[Barricade]] - +1~2~3~8% Armor. *[[File:synergy-incoming.jpg]] '''Allies''' - [[Grindor]], [[Mixmaster]] - 1~2~3~8% Armor. *[[File:synergy-outgoing.jpg]] '''Enemies''' - [[Optimus Prime (MV1)]] - +1~2~3~8% Attack Rating. *[[File:synergy-outgoing.jpg]] '''Forged to Serve''' - [[Megatron (ROTF)]] - Megatron has 20~40~80% chance to Stun his opponent when they reach 20 impair charges. *[[File:synergy-incoming.jpg]] '''Forged to Serve''' - Megatron - Megatron's minions each provide him with a unique ability. In return Megatron provides +2~3~8% Armor. *[[File:synergy-outgoing.jpg]] '''Leadership''' (5-Star) - Acting as a beacon of leadership for the team, all lower tier teammates gain +10% Critical Damage. ==Strategy== ===Player=== Bonecrusher is "the master of bleeds", albeit more passively than offensively. Use his first special to deal more damage as it has the highest chance for bleed and deals a reasonable amount of damage. Get enough Bleeds on the opponent at once and they're essentially Power Locked while Bonecrusher gains a Power Flow boost. ===Opponent=== ==== General ==== Do not use Bots that constantly hit with Critical melee attacks, or else they will quickly lose health from Bleeding. Since Brawlers and most Demolition bots have a low melee critical rate (and [[Thundercracker]] literally cannot score them), they are the best classes to use against Bonecrusher. It is best to fight at ranged, as Bonecrusher can't inflict Bleeds at a ranged distance. ==== Rulers of Kaon ==== His Reflect Ranged mod limits your scope of attacks that you can use against him. You'll have to fight up-close against him. ===Strong Match-ups=== * [[Sideswipe]] and cinematic [[Bumblebee (DOTM)|Bumblebee]] will be punished with every critical hit. * Agile bots like [[Arcee]], [[Bumblebee]] and [[Jazz]] are very likely to hit with critical melees, thus making them Bleed. *[[Wheeljack]] - Bleeds ignore the Force Shield, and Wheeljack hates all damaging debuffs including Bleeds. *[[Hot Rod]] - Decelerating the master of bleeds and sticking to melee hits will put Hot Rod in a disadvantage against Bonecrusher. *[[Drift]] - Gaining Precision and Critical Damage buffs on Combo will become a mistake. *[[Megatron (ROTF)]] - Bleeds will ignore the Demolition King's armor and Megatron really hates damaging debuffs including Bleeds. ===Weak Match-ups=== *[[Optimus Prime (MV1)]] can recover health and convert the second bleed into Power while Bleeding and attacking his foe. *[[Ironhide (ROTF)]] - Ironhide's critical hits are all in this ranged attacks, which Bonecrusher's Bleeds have no answer to. * Though Bonecrusher has the ability to inflict critical hits, [[Grimlock]] can Purify Bleeds, putting "the master of bleeds" at a serious disadvantage. * [[Optimus Primal]] has critical armor, thus Bonecrusher will lose the ability to land Critical Hits and the Bleeds he inflicts will soon become an advantage for Optimus Primal’s first Special Attack. * When [[Tantrum]] becomes frenzied, he shrugs off all Bleeds. * [[Thundercracker]] can’t score critical hits and Bonecrusher's passive Bleeds rely on enemy Crits to activate, Also, any other Bleeds Bonecrusher inflicts will be Purified and turned into Melee Damage, placing the walking cactus in a... dire situation. * Megatronus the [[Megatronus|Master of the Demolitions]] has low critical melee damage and when he does inflict’s critical melee hits, his Relic of Preservation will decrease the damage of the bleeds especially the critical hits bonecrusher inflicts leaving the master of bleeds with his most powerful tools doing almost nothing to the Master of Demolitions. ===Recommended Modules=== Pair the "Master of Bleeds" with these Mods and dish out enhanced pure hate! * [[Harm Accelerator]] - The Master of Bleeds' perfect match. This Mod will turn his Bleeds into a hemorrhage. * [[Robot Resource]] & Superconductors [[Superconductor 1000|1000]] and [[Superconductor 2000|2000]] - In addition to the increased Power Rate with that pure hatred, increases the chance he will use his Special I. * [[E.M.I. Module]] - Ranged Attacks aren't going to save you now. Forcing your opponent to fight Melee will increase the chance Bonecrusher will Bleed. ==Obtainment== * Bot Crystals * Bonecrusher Arenas **Focused Hatred (3-Star) **Blood Bank (4-Star) * Punishment Crystal * December 2019 set * October 2020 set ==Gallery== Bonecrusher.jpg Bonecrusher featured Beta.png|Beta featured Bonecrusher Icon.jpg Bonecrusher Icon New.jpg Bonecrusher portrait.png Bonecrusher portrait New.png Bonecrusher Icon v3.jpg|v5.0 icon. Note empty black space. Bonecrusher portrait v3.png Bruisers_Crystal_banner.jpg == Trivia == * His vehicle mode is a modified Buffalo H MPCV. ==External Links== [[Category:Bots]] [[Category:Decepticons]] [[Category:Cinematic]] [[Category:Cinematic Decepticons]] [[Category:Warrior]] [[Category:1-Star Bots]] [[Category:5-Star Bots]] [[Category:Revenge Of The Fallen]] [[Category:MV1]] [[Category:ROTF]] [[Category:2-Star Bots]] [[Category:3-Star Bots]] [[Category:4-Star Bots]]
